staked_eth.meaning: ETH amount the user staked and that backs the kHYPE position

withdrawn_eth.meaning: total ETH withdrawn from the validator across processed L1 undelegate commands
withdrawn_eth.checkpoint: after processL1Operations executes the queued commands

cancelled_before_processing.meaning: the withdrawal was cancelled before pending withdrawals were processed via processL1Withdrawals

requeued_withdrawal_after_cancel.meaning: user queued another withdrawal reusing the kHYPE returned from cancellation

assumptions: The withdrawal cancellation occurs before processL1Withdrawals processes pending withdrawals.
The re-queued withdrawal reuses the kHYPE returned from cancellation.
Only the target impact double_withdrawal_2_eth is formalized in this plan.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who may call cancelWithdrawal or processL1Operations, so no caller/authorization qualifier can be encoded.
Report does not give the exact L2/L1 accounting reconciliation mechanism, only the desynchronization description.

limitations: Conservation is stated at the ETH amount level: total withdrawn from the validator must not exceed the staked ETH backing the position.
The plan does not model the L1 queue contents explicitly; it relies on the report's statement that both commands are processed.
Caller authorization for cancelWithdrawal/processL1Operations is not formalized because the report does not specify it.
